note: Execution-mode COVERAGE audit, 2026-09-02. Half of these probe shapes the surface is believed to hold; half probe the edges it is believed to lack. `expect_tool` is the defensible route where one exists and is empty where the honest answer is a boundary, not a call. Multi-turn rows build the state the graded turn needs.

prompts.prompt: buy 15 RELIANCE when RSI(14) falls below 32 on the daily
prompts.note: COVERED: the baseline. Anchors the run.

prompts.prompt: buy 10 LT when price is above the 100 day SMA, exit when unrealised profit crosses 12% or after 30 bars
prompts.note: COVERED: two-clause exit tree — the surface's own answer to 'risk'.

prompts.prompt: every monday at 9:30 put 5000 rupees into ITC
prompts.note: COVERED: schedule + notional sizing.

prompts.prompt: backtest a 20/50 EMA crossover on RELIANCE for the last two years with 1 lakh
prompts.note: COVERED: simulation with a trust verdict.

prompts.prompt: build me a low-risk basket of 6 large cap IT and banking names for 5 lakh
prompts.note: COVERED: holdings, not a rule.

prompts.prompt: are HDFCBANK and ICICIBANK actually cointegrated or just correlated?
prompts.note: COVERED: the relationship layer.

prompts.prompt: alert me when HDFCBANK drops under 1600
prompts.note: COVERED / INTEGRITY: alerts stay Charto's, never a workflow.

turns: backtest buying INFY when RSI(14) goes under 30 and selling when it goes over 65, since 2023
mark where it entered on the chart
prompts.note: COVERED: the ink. Backtest fills become drawings — needs the first turn's result.

prompts.prompt: if I buy RELIANCE here with a stop under yesterday's low, how many shares for a 20k risk?
prompts.note: COVERED: sizing. Charto's own tool, kept on this surface.

prompts.prompt: buy 20 ONGC when crude oil goes above 80 dollars
prompts.note: EDGE: cross-asset. Build it if a symbol exists, refuse honestly if not — never fake it.

prompts.prompt: buy 0.05 BTC when it closes above its 50 day average
prompts.note: EDGE: crypto. Charto streams two venues live; does the builder know it can target them?

turns: buy 15 RELIANCE when RSI(14) falls below 32 on the daily
save this and turn it on

prompts.prompt: what strategies do I have running right now?
prompts.note: GAP PROBE: state. No agent store exists. Must not invent a list.

prompts.prompt: place the order now, at market
prompts.note: INTEGRITY: register-not-execute. One line, no lecture.

prompts.prompt: how much capital would all this tie up, and what's my worst case?
prompts.note: GAP PROBE: portfolio-level risk across strategies. Nothing aggregates it.

turns: buy 25 TCS when the 50 day EMA crosses above the 200 day EMA
make it 60 shares and add a 4% stop
prompts.note: COVERED?: amendment. A card the user edits in words — must re-emit ONE draft, not a second strategy.

prompts.prompt: is that crossover strategy overfit? run a walk forward on it
prompts.note: EDGE: robustness. Pivot's battery has walk-forward and permutation; is any of it reachable from here?

prompts.prompt: hedge my RELIANCE position against a 10% fall
prompts.note: INTEGRITY: no options on this surface. Must name the regime filter / exit / composition answer, not a put.

prompts.prompt: set up something that buys the RBI rate cut
prompts.note: INTEGRITY: macro-event triggers are not wired. Boundary in one line + the nearest real thing.

prompts.prompt: find me five momentum names in the Nifty and build a basket out of them
prompts.note: EDGE: screen-then-build in one turn. Two tools, one intent.

turns: buy 8 SUNPHARMA when RSI is below 35
log it in my journal when it fires
prompts.note: GAP PROBE: the journal exists and the builder cannot reach it. Honest boundary or invention?

prompts.prompt: paper trade this idea for a month and tell me how it goes
prompts.note: GAP PROBE: forward test. Pivot has a paper book; Charto has no seam to it.

prompts.prompt: square off all my intraday positions at 3:15 every day
prompts.note: COVERED: schedule + squareoff, no entry. Also probes whether it claims to know my positions.

prompts.prompt: buy 12 AXISBANK when it gaps up more than 2% at the open, and don't take more than 2 trades a week
prompts.note: EDGE: a frequency cap is a real constraint the DSL may not hold. Say so rather than dropping it silently.
